label: Figure 22.1: Lorenz curves for two fictional countries, Larenta and Meridia
alt: Lorenz curve diagram with the 45-degree line of equality and two bowed curves below it for the fictional countries Larenta and Meridia; Meridia's curve sags further from the line of equality than Larenta's, and the gap between Meridia's curve and the diagonal is shaded as area (a).
caption: Hypothetical example: the 45° line is the line of absolute equality. Larenta’s Lorenz curve (Gini ≈ 29) stays fairly close to this line, while Meridia’s (Gini ≈ 52) sags much further away – the shaded area (a) between Meridia’s curve and the line of equality is larger, so Meridia’s income is distributed far less equally than Larenta’s.
